title: scrolltemplates
summary: Benilla's current ScrollTemplates.xml is shared framework plumbing, not a standalone window: it now carries both the fixed-row faux-scroll kit and the variable-height real ScrollFrame kit, including shared slider art, arrow/wheel routing, range/offset math, clipping, and synchronization. MSUIClient realizes those desktop affordances through its native panel laws and render helpers: the keybindings scrollbar, SkillFrame arrow/knob/track-drag law, quest-panel clipping and wheel scrolling, and per-panel paging where the reference pages. The 2026-08-23 source expansion adds framework behavior rather than a new authored desktop surface, so no standalone counterpart is expected.
